insulin_resistant.title: Low-Glycaemic Index Diet
insulin_resistant.desc: Avoid refined carbs and sugar. Focus on complex carbohydrates, lean protein, and healthy fats to improve insulin sensitivity.

insulin_resistant.title: Resistance Training
insulin_resistant.desc: Aim for 3-4 sessions per week of strength training. Building muscle mass significantly improves insulin receptor sensitivity.

insulin_resistant.title: Consistent Sleep Schedule
insulin_resistant.desc: Aim for 7-9 hours of quality sleep. Poor sleep elevates cortisol which directly worsens insulin resistance.

insulin_resistant.title: Inositol (Myo + D-Chiro)
insulin_resistant.desc: A 40:1 ratio of Myo-inositol and D-chiro-inositol is clinically shown to improve insulin sensitivity in PCOD patients.

insulin_resistant.title: Cortisol Management
insulin_resistant.desc: Incorporate daily mindfulness, yoga, or breathwork. Chronic stress elevates cortisol levels, compounding insulin resistance.

inflammatory.title: Anti-Inflammatory Foods
inflammatory.desc: Focus on turmeric, berries, leafy greens, and avoid processed foods, gluten, or dairy if you have sensitivities.

inflammatory.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
inflammatory.desc: Consider high-quality fish oil or algae oil supplements to systematically reduce systemic inflammation markers.

inflammatory.title: Probiotics & Prebiotics
inflammatory.desc: Support your microbiome with fermented foods or a probiotic supplement to reduce immune-driven inflammation.

inflammatory.title: Optimize Rest
inflammatory.desc: Prioritize restorative sleep. Inflammation heals during deep sleep phases, making 8 hours crucial.

inflammatory.title: Reduce Environmental Stressors
inflammatory.desc: Minimize exposure to endocrine disruptors in plastics and cosmetics to lower toxic burden.

adrenal.title: Aggressive Cortisol Management
adrenal.desc: This is your primary focus. Prioritize daily meditation, somatic tracking, and radical boundary setting to lower DHEA-S.

adrenal.title: Reduce Stimulants
adrenal.desc: Strictly limit caffeine and alcohol. Replace coffee with matcha or herbal teas to prevent adrenal spikes.

adrenal.title: Magnesium Glycinate
adrenal.desc: Take 300-400mg before bed to soothe the nervous system, lower cortisol, and improve sleep depth.

adrenal.title: Low-Intensity Movement
adrenal.desc: Avoid HIIT or extreme cardio which spikes cortisol. Opt for pilates, walking, and restorative yoga.

adrenal.title: Protect Your Circadian Rhythm
adrenal.desc: Get morning sunlight within 30 minutes of waking and limit blue light at night to stabilize your cortisol curve.

post_pill.title: Patience is Key
post_pill.desc: Your body may take 3-6 months to restore natural ovulation and communication between the brain and ovaries.

post_pill.title: Replenish Nutrients
post_pill.desc: The pill depletes B-vitamins, zinc, and magnesium. Consider a high-quality multivitamin to restore baseline levels.

post_pill.title: Support Liver Detoxification
post_pill.desc: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower) help your liver safely process and clear synthetic hormones.

post_pill.title: Gentle Cycle Syncing
post_pill.desc: Don't overstress the body. Focus on consistent, moderate movement while waiting for your cycle to return.

post_pill.title: Monitor Basal Body Temp
post_pill.desc: Track your BBT every morning to definitively confirm when natural ovulation successfully resumes.
